messages:
olivia: Quick late-shift status rollup — embedding ingest is degraded since ~03:10 UTC. Symptoms: queue depth up, some ingestion workers restarting with OOM. Mitigations applied: throttled low-priority regen jobs, enabled read-through fallback to S3 for cold keys, paused non-critical nightly evals. Plan: drain current batches, restart two affected workers, rollback canary PR if errors spike. Will hand primary watch to Leo at 04:00 UTC. Anyone picking up anything else?

devin: seeing OOMs on p3-medium-2 replicas around 03:09 — looks like a batch commit memory growth. I pushed a small revert (PR #4523) to undo the recent commit that touched batch pooling. If canary stays unhappy I'll roll it back. ETA for safe restart? :clock3:

olivia: ETA ~20m to finish draining current batches, then restart both workers. I tagged PR #4523 for immediate rollback on canary if error_rate > 1.5%.

sam: I'm watching the latency and error dashboards. If traces spike I'll attach a flamegraph. Also FYI I bumped ingress throttle to 75% for low-priority queue to give the ingest path breathing room. :thumbsup:

leo: alertbot triggered embed-queue-high at 03:14, suppressed duplicates. I've increased embed-cache TTL temporarily to reduce regen pressure. Pinged infra for node-level checks.

alertbot: Incident INC-2023-084 created at 03:15 UTC. Severity: minor. Owners: olivia, devin. Current state: degraded ingest, auto-throttle active.

devin: thought — autoscaler cooldown is 300s. For these spikes that seems slow; proposing reducing to 120s on the ingest ASG to react faster. Example change I can open:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 12
  cooldown_seconds: 120
```
Would appreciate signoff from infra.

olivia: +1 to testing a shorter cooldown on a canary policy. I'll file the infra ticket and tag you, Devin. Keep an eye on CPU churn if we do this.

sam: FYI I'll be offline from 04:10–06:10 UTC (short break). If something critical happens DM me, otherwise Leo/Maya take primary.

leo: I'll own primary until 04:30, then pass to Maya for the overnight stretch. I'll keep the incident doc updated (INC-2023-084).

maya: Standby from 04:30. Please leave runbook notes in the incident doc — I'll follow the restart checklist if needed.

olivia: TL;DR for handover: degraded embed ingest -> throttled low-priority jobs, enabled S3 fallback, paused heavy evals, rollback PR #4523 on canary if error rate climbs, restart two OOMing workers after batch drain, consider autoscaler cooldown change (300s -> 120s) for ingest ASG. Next sync/check @ 04:00 UTC. Add any blockers or asks below before I step away. :wave:
